title: Lake Louise and Lake Moraine Half Day Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries

cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Experience the Canadian Rockies with a company that puts comfort, flexibility, and local expertise first. Our experienced local guides share fascinating stories about the region's history, wildlife, geology, and hidden gems while ensuring you have plenty of time to explore at every stop. We travel in clean, comfortable commercial vehicles equipped with complimentary bottled water, snacks, and high-speed Starlink Wi-Fi. Unlike rushed sightseeing trips, our tours are carefully paced to maximize your time at each destination, with convenient pickup and drop-off included. Whether you're visiting for the first time or returning to discover more, we focus on creating a relaxed, memorable, and personalized Rocky Mountain experience.
